imgready · key minter

Local-only tool. Save this file on your computer; do not upload it anywhere. The token is stored in your browser's localStorage and never leaves your machine except when calling your own worker.

One-time setup

Default works. Change only if you mounted the worker on a different domain.
Saved locally in this browser. Click "Forget token" below to clear.

Mint a new key

Stored alongside the key for your records. Optional, but recommended.
If set, the key only works when called from that domain. Substring match.
What happens when you click "Mint key": the tool POSTs to /api/issue-key, the worker generates a fresh key with an HMAC signature, stores it in your KV namespace alongside the email and domain you entered, and returns the key. You can then verify it works by pasting it into imgready.init({licenseKey: '...'}) on a page using the SDK.
